title: Tourists told to avoid Tinglayan, Kalinga amid tribal dispute

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Tourists and other visitors have been advised to postpone travel to seven barangays in Tinglayan, Kalinga amid tensions linked to a longstanding tribal dispute between the Butbut and Tulgao tribes. The municipal government’s advisory could affect tourism in Tinglayan, where guests get tattoos delivered the indigenous way by renowned mambabatok (tattoo artist)
